acceptance.title: Toolchain, features and spans
acceptance.positiveCase: adapter accepts declared feature and span

acceptance.title: Old/new compatibility
acceptance.positiveCase: old consumer accepts old ce.v1 artifact
acceptance.negativeCase: old consumer rejects new language value

acceptance.title: Malformed input and rollback/versioning
acceptance.positiveCase: versioned profile can be selected explicitly

acceptance.title: Producer comparison
acceptance.positiveCase: producer is assessed against primary source
acceptance.negativeCase: syntax support is not reported as semantic resolution

acceptance.title: Demand-gated pilot
acceptance.negativeCase: no demand does not choose a language

acceptance.title: Discovery ownership patterns
acceptance.negativeCase: implicit host walk is not a manifest

acceptance.title: Ambiguous and marker-free inputs
acceptance.negativeCase: marker-free ambiguity cannot be successful empty

acceptance.title: Sealed layout inventories
acceptance.negativeCase: overlap is deduplicated without dropping owner

acceptance.title: Deterministic output
acceptance.negativeCase: operational timestamps do not enter canonical bytes

acceptance.title: Future precision, recall, links and spans
acceptance.positiveCase: future measures use independent gold inventory
acceptance.negativeCase: static shape tests claim no semantic accuracy

acceptance.title: Safe execution and failure boundary
acceptance.negativeCase: no script, credential, network or escape is accepted

acceptance.title: Existing contract and prior issue boundaries
acceptance.negativeCase: new closed-vocabulary value is not backported to old consumer

acceptance.title: Recommendation, dissent, unknowns and pilot
acceptance.positiveCase: pilot requires demand and a stop rule
acceptance.negativeCase: research completion does not imply implementation

constraints: No parser adoption or new-language choice without recorded demand.
Do not modify schema/v1/record.schema.json or change the ce.v1 language vocabulary.
Do not implement production repository discovery or add runtime dependencies.
Do not execute analyzed repository build/package scripts or inherit credentials.
Do not use undeclared network access or traverse outside an immutable source snapshot.
Do not claim fixture conformance proves semantic resolution or all repository layouts.
Keep #33 exchange-envelope, #12 contract-document evidence, #6 resolution, #37/#48 frozen-source boundary and #23 corpus limitation distinct.
Issue 42 excludes DDD business-object, domain-event and integration-event grading.
